scope: Targeted search for exact or near-exact predecessors of the evoTS moving-optimum reciprocal causal congruence and mechanistic half-life identified-set result.
search_axes: reciprocal versus exogenous OU feedback observational equivalence
correlated/common innovations in partially observed OU systems

closest_prior_art.work: Jensen 2014, Statistical Inference for Partially Observed Diffusion Processes
closest_prior_art.concedes: Two-dimensional OU identifiability under partial observation is prior art.
Exact structural identifiability and identifiable parameter combinations for partially observed linear/near-linear SDEs are prior art.

closest_prior_art.work: Kania 2026, Law Equivalence for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Dynamics Driven by Levy Noise
closest_prior_art.concedes: OU law comparison/equivalence under changes in drift is prior art; not the same as the present identical scalar finite-dimensional likelihood construction.

closest_prior_art.work: Bartoszek et al. 2012, A phylogenetic comparative method for studying multivariate adaptation
closest_prior_art.concedes: Reciprocal adaptive OU coupling and randomly evolving predictors are prior art.

closest_prior_art.work: Voje 2023, Fitting and evaluating univariate and multivariate models of within-lineage evolution
closest_prior_art.concedes: evoTS methodology already explicitly describes reciprocal adaptation and correlated or uncorrelated stochastic changes.
Linear SDE/OU models for Granger-causal biological and palaeontological time-series analysis are prior art.

closest_prior_art.work: Ringen 2026, Trait coevolution and causal inference using generalized dynamic phylogenetic models
closest_prior_art.concedes: One-way versus reciprocal evolutionary effects and the dependence of causal interpretation on assumptions are active explicit methodology.

closest_prior_art.work: Adams 2024 thesis / Recke, Adams & Hansen non-Gaussian graphical precision work
closest_prior_art.concedes: Causal conclusions from OU observational distributions under declared structural/noise conditions are prior art.

bounded_search_conclusion: No located work simultaneously targeted the implemented evoTS logL.joint.OU.BM nonstationary trait-only likelihood, constructed an exogenous-optimum versus reciprocal-hidden-state identical observed law, derived H_direct in [H_OU, infinity), and supplied the common-shock sensitivity envelope. This is a search outcome, not a priority proof.
novelty_boundary: Claim only a likelihood-specific causal identified set and replacement/sensitivity analysis tied to empirical moving-optimum practice; do not claim generic OU non-identifiability, reciprocal OU adaptation, causal SDEs, or OU law equivalence as new.
